messages:
zoe: opened PR to update sylph-6b model card with compatibility notes for q4_cpu variants + tiny SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/6234

zoe: short asks: (1) add a compatibility row listing affected variants, (2) paste p95 bench numbers for 4k/16k contexts, (3) small python/js snippets showing routing hints and how to detect fallback in response metadata.

priya: quick runtime context: sylph-6b-q4_cpu disables on-GPU KV cache above ~8k to avoid OOM; requests will route to a disk-cache worker and emit kernel.fallback_reason. recommend docs call out exact variants and the metric key.

ken: bench numbers (p95 tokens/sec): ctx=4096 -> q4_cpu 2.3 t/s, fp16-full 7.1 t/s; ctx=16384 -> q4_cpu falls back and tail latency ~3.5x. I'll add a tiny table in the PR.

zoe: added a new section and used anchor "compatibility-notes" but lint flagged a duplicate anchor.

lint-bot: ERROR docs/models/sylph-6b.md: anchor "compatibility-notes" already defined in docs/models/vega13b.md line 19.

priya: use a model-scoped anchor like "sylph6b-compat". Also wording suggestion: "KV cache: not available on sylph-6b-q4_cpu variants for contexts >8k; streaming may fallback to disk-cache worker (kernel.fallback_reason)."

zoe: updated anchor to sylph6b-compat, added the bench table and wording, and pasted the Python snippet:```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient()
resp = c.generate(
    model="sylph-6b",
    input="<long prefix>",
    routing={"prefer_variant": "fp16-full", "allow_fallback": True}
)
if resp.metadata.get("kernel.fallback_reason"):
    print("fallback used:", resp.metadata["kernel.fallback_reason"])```

zoe: JS streaming example too:```js
const client = new RedwoodClient();
const stream = await client.stream({ model: 'sylph-6b', routing: { prefer_variant: 'fp16-full' } });
for await (const chunk of stream) {
  if (chunk.meta && chunk.meta['kernel.fallback_reason']) {
    console.warn('fallback variant used — see model card')
  }
  process.stdout.write(chunk.text)
}
```

docs-bot: preview deployed for PR #6234  https://deploy-preview.docs/6234  view sylph-6b card under "Compatibility & performance".

ken: quick nit: list affected variants explicitly in the card: sylph-6b-q4_cpu, sylph-6b-q4_cpu-smallmap. also add a one-line billing note: "Hosted billing per-token unchanged; expect higher tail-latency."

priya: wording looks good. I'll add a runtime changelog line referencing kernel.fallback_reason after merge.

lint-bot: re-run: no anchor duplicates. small markdown warning: line-length in docs/models/sylph-6b.md line 52.

zoe: assigning follow-ups: @ken confirm bench formatting, @priya add runtime changelog, @docs-bot merge when CI green. thanks everyone :tada:

docs-bot: PR merged and preview removed.
